mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers investor concerns about weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.4pp over 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and reduces corporate profitability expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a flat or declining GDP growth (GDPC1), indicates stagflationary pressures, prompting central bank inaction and eroding equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 1.0% YoY
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.8%), signals labor market overheating and raises expectations of imminent monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 3.8%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum, combined with a flattening or inversion of the yield curve (implied by stable CPIAUCSL), signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1700k units, combined with a contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS), indicates a collapse in housing and consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 1700.0 and RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
